Home.metaDescription: Find providers and organizations on Bookie, then reserve a time that works.
Home.overline: Welcome to the future of booking
Home.body: Book local services or manage your calendar with Bookie. One platform for providers and the people who book them.
Home.featuresSubtitle: Everything you need to manage appointments in one place.

calendar.title: Smart calendar
calendar.body: Open hours, breaks and service duration become bookable slots. Collision-free, on every device.

booking.title: Book in a few taps
booking.body: Pick a service, a day and a time. The provider confirms — no phone tag.

services.title: Service menus
services.body: Duration and price on every offering, so clients know exactly what they are booking.

categories.title: Browse by specialty
categories.body: From salons to clinics, find the right kind of provider without guessing.

orgs.title: Organizations
orgs.body: Studios and clinics list under one roof, with the people who take bookings inside.
